text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after we've
successfully made
it through the Twinkle
Series...

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
This week we have with us three
individuals you
could comfortably say
represent their very
generation!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet, Vodka, and Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Thanks!
Thank
you for having us.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you! Now, if I could ask you
all to
please take your seats.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
All right then, it's time for some
questions! Firstly,
what are your most
special memories from the
past years
involving the three of you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'd have to say the Oka Sho. I'd just lost
to Vodka
in the Tulip Sho and I was
incredibly fired up.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, Machan had thrown
down the
gauntlet as well, so I stepped
into the fray
determined to win!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you want one involving all of us, it's
gotta be
when Machan said she wasn't
gonna go for the
Tiara tour anymore.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She had no regrets or nothing when she
made
that call, and man, I thought she
was so awesome
for doing it!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are so many that come to mind for
me.
But... if I had to choose just one...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It would be when we all made an
independent film
together.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
I see! And in fact, Aston Machan was
actually
kind enough to provide us with
some footage
from this film!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mortified, Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka
watch on
powerlessly as footage of the
film begins playing
in the studio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Stop right there, Machan the
Super Spy!
You've eluded me for the last
time!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is from the early days. It's a
masterpiece we
all worked together to
make.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Are we really showing this to people?!

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
We can always replace this footage with

something else once we're done taping
the show,
so please let us know if there
are any issues.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, I apologize! You don't have to go
to the
trouble of—

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, actually—
Yeah, no way!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry, but I'd really appreciate
if you
could replace that footage with
something else!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But you both looked like you were really
into it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It was great at the time! But now... I
don't want
anyone seeing me delivering
lines so
monotonously!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, your whole "Scarlet Queen" image
is gonna
be ruined.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's not like your line readings were
anything
special!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you need a clip to show, we can find
something
else! I could even pick
something out for you!
That's okay,
right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hold up, let me find the clip! There's no way I'm leavin' the choice up to you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely not. You'll just choose clips
that make
you look cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And you'll go with a bunch of lame,
serious ones!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should just use the original
footage,
then. It's not too cool, but not
too serious either.
It's lovely.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nooope!
Anything but that!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. All right, then let's settle this with
a race.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whoever comes first will earn the right
to choose.
Then none of us can
complain.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Good idea! I'm on board!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't blame me when this ends in tears
for you
guys!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the filming, I arrive at the studio to
pick up
the three racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wait and wait, but they don't seem to
be
showing up. What's more, it sounds
like there's
some commotion outside.
Entertaining the idea
that it could be
them, I go out to investigate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, I spot the faces I'm looking

for—they're all doing stretches at the
freestyle
race track!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A 1,600-meter right-handed race... Hm.
There's
no way I can lose this one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We're having a once-in-a-lifetime
showdown to
determine which video will
be used in the show.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Who do you think will win, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka, Scarlet, or me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Machan! Get to the gate already!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, too bad. You'll just have to say it
later.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Congrats, Machan. I knew you could do
it."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the race begins. The
three shadows
overlap as they dart
forwards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Who's the strongest? Who's the fastest?
The
answer is moments away, and I can't
wait to find
out.
